name: Allowed Values Functions
description: Bind a PHP static method to a field as its allowed-values function via a #[AllowedValuesFunction] attribute, instead of editing field storage config or writing a hook.
project_description: Allowed Values Functions lets a developer designate a class method as the allowed-values callback for a list/options field simply by adding a #[AllowedValuesFunction(entityTypeId, fieldName)] PHP attribute to a public static method. Without this module you would set the callback directly in the field's storage config (in a config file or via hook_entity_field_storage_info_alter()); with it, the module discovers attributed methods at container-compile time and wires the field storage setting 'allowed_values_function' to your method automatically. Attributes are repeatable so one method can serve several entity-type/field pairs, and an admin report at /admin/reports/fields/allowed-values-functions lists every field-to-callable binding. Requires Drupal 11; no configuration UI, permissions, or dependencies.
